title: Design System: Forge Delivery Create Page

components.name: Creation Page Footer
components.description: Final-step ready specimen. Runtime renders Cancel/Next on step one, Previous/Next on intermediate steps, and Previous/Create on confirmation. A blocking reason disables the primary action.

narrative.overview: A validated four-step creation workflow inside the incumbent Forge shell. Keep the sidebar, typography and restrained orange; reduce cognitive load through progressive disclosure, a live configuration summary and explicit completion gates. Existing-sheet editing remains a native three-tab dialog.
keyCharacteristics: Four steps with preserved inputs and validated navigation.
Mutually exclusive List inputs with visible anomalies and exact target/valid-count checks.
Optional default Tag and selected-first Skills; sheet-scoped members at confirmation.
Create Skill opens the shared native form/upload chooser; both subflows retain unpublished inputs and require explicit publication.
Desktop sticky summary, mobile disclosure and validation beside sticky actions. No draft-saving UI.
dos: Preserve Forge tokens and existing-sheet editing.
Keep missing conditions and count differences explicit.
Retain published Skills when cancelling the sheet.
donts: Do not allow route anchors to bypass step validation.
Do not silently drop duplicate or unmatched List entries.
Do not claim successful browser submission: safety review blocked that final action.
